note: Second Ring sample (17 named specialists). Each has a quest (acts.json SR.<CALLSIGN>), one memory fragment, idle barks and recall last words. Recall last words: four variants (warned/unwarned x named/unnamed); named variants play if the player used the unit's real name before its Recall. donor_name is what the player learns via KEEPER open_unit_file.

GIRDER.hook: Terrified of heights in memory; works on the top of every dome.

memory_fragment.speaker: GIRDER
memory_fragment.text: My da took me up the Forth Bridge on a works visit. I was seven. I froze on the first ladder. He carried me down, and he never told my mother.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: GIRDER
idle.text: Rib nine's out a millimetre. I'll have it.

idle.speaker: GIRDER
idle.text: Don't wave. I'll wave back and then where will we be.

warned.speaker: GIRDER
warned.text: I'll be up top when they come. Seems right. Last thing I'll see is the view.

unwarned.speaker: GIRDER
unwarned.text: Oh. Hello. Mind the ladder, it's a long way down.

named_warned.speaker: GIRDER
named_warned.text: I'll be up top. Callum Reid, sixty metres up, hands not shaking. Tell my da.

named_unwarned.speaker: GIRDER
named_unwarned.text: Oh. Hello. I'm Callum. Mind the ladder, it's a long way down.

KILN.hook: Wants to print a cathedral before anyone arrives.

memory_fragment.speaker: KILN
memory_fragment.text: Saint Chad's, in Birmingham. My nan lit a candle every Thursday. I'd count the pipes on the organ while she prayed. Ninety-one. I never told her.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: KILN
idle.text: Every wall wants to be a vault, if you let it.

idle.speaker: KILN
idle.text: Quiet in here. That's the point.

warned.speaker: KILN
warned.text: They'll use it for something. That's enough.

named_warned.speaker: KILN
named_warned.text: They'll use it for something. Put Patrick Doyle on the foundation stone. Small. Down at the bottom.

named_unwarned.speaker: KILN
named_unwarned.text: Shh. It echoes. Patrick. That's me. Listen to it come back.

KILN.act_v: In Act V KILN's finished cathedral is the Meridian sales and welcome hall; see collectibles CITS ephemera.

SPINDLE.hook: Stitches each unit's callsign inside their suit lining.

memory_fragment.speaker: SPINDLE
memory_fragment.text: My mam did name tapes every September, all five of us. She'd sew them in at the kitchen table with the radio on, and swear at the needle.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: SPINDLE
idle.text: Hold still, I've got a pin in my mouth.

idle.speaker: SPINDLE
idle.text: Elbows go first. They always go first.

idle.speaker: SPINDLE
idle.text: I've done four hundred and twelve tapes. Not one spelled wrong.

warned.speaker: SPINDLE
warned.text: I'll finish the last few tapes first. They'll want to know whose suits they are.

unwarned.speaker: SPINDLE
unwarned.text: Can it wait? I'm halfway through a hem.

named_warned.speaker: SPINDLE
named_warned.text: Finished the tapes. Did my own last. Joan Hartley. Tight stitches.

named_unwarned.speaker: SPINDLE
named_unwarned.text: Can it wait? I'm Joan, pet. I'm halfway through a hem.

SPINDLE.act_iv: After 4.4 SPINDLE offers to finish P1's tape. Options: ROWAN / PIONEER-1 / leave it blank. The choice is cosmetic and appears in Fugitive mode on the suit lining.

act_iv_lines.speaker: SPINDLE
act_iv_lines.text: I left room on your tape. Want me to finish it now?

act_iv_lines.speaker: SPINDLE
act_iv_lines.text: Right you are. Tight stitches. They'll last.

HARBOR.hook: Tunes rovers, races them at night.

memory_fragment.speaker: HARBOR
memory_fragment.text: Bathurst. Dad's ute. I was fourteen and not supposed to be driving it, and I took the Mountain at a hundred and twenty with my heart in my mouth.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: HARBOR
idle.text: Nights are for driving. Days are for fixing what you broke.

warned.speaker: HARBOR
warned.text: Give us the keys to the fast one. If I'm going, I'm going quick.

named_warned.speaker: HARBOR
named_warned.text: Give us the keys to the fast one. Lachlan Byrne, last lap.

named_unwarned.speaker: HARBOR
named_unwarned.text: Who's parked across my bay? Lachie. Lachie Byrne. That's who.

PLUMB.hook: Draws every map by hand, refuses the HUD.

memory_fragment.speaker: PLUMB
memory_fragment.text: Ordnance Survey, Sheet 98, me grandad's, foxed at the folds. We walked every footpath on it before he died. Every one.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: PLUMB
idle.text: I'll find my own way, thanks.

warned.speaker: PLUMB
warned.text: I've drawn where they are. They're coming down the east road. I'll not be on it.

named_warned.speaker: PLUMB
named_warned.text: I've signed my maps. Arthur Pennock. Believe the pencil.

named_unwarned.speaker: PLUMB
named_unwarned.text: You're standing on my baseline. Arthur Pennock's baseline.

PLUMB.act_iv: PLUMB's hand-drawn sky sheet (collectible LOG.PLUMB.sky) shows eleven extra dots along the equator, drawn in Act II and crossed out with 'smudge?'.

ORCHARD.hook: FURROW's apprentice; grafts the first apple tree on Mars.

memory_fragment.speaker: ORCHARD
memory_fragment.text: Grandaddy said you plant an orchard for your grandchildren. You don't plant it for you. He planted pecans the year I was born.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: ORCHARD
idle.text: Mister Furrow's the patientest man alive.

warned.speaker: ORCHARD
warned.text: Will somebody water the trees? Somebody has to water the trees.

named_warned.speaker: ORCHARD
named_warned.text: Somebody water the trees. Ruth Ann planted them. Ruth Ann Mosley.

named_unwarned.speaker: ORCHARD
named_unwarned.text: Careful of the graft. I'm Ruth Ann. Careful.

TIDE.hook: Raises fish nobody will eat for fifty years.

memory_fragment.speaker: TIDE
memory_fragment.text: Kaikoura. Dad's boat, the crayfish pots in the cold, and a seal that followed us every morning like a dog.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: TIDE
idle.text: Water's two degrees. They like it.

idle.speaker: TIDE
idle.text: Counted four hundred. There were four hundred and one yesterday.

warned.speaker: TIDE
warned.text: Will they look after the fish? Tell them it's two degrees. They like it at two.

unwarned.speaker: TIDE
unwarned.text: Keep it down, you'll frighten them.

named_warned.speaker: TIDE
named_warned.text: Tell them it's two degrees. Tell them Aroha kept them.

named_unwarned.speaker: TIDE
named_unwarned.text: Keep it down, you'll frighten them. I'm Aroha. Shh.

LANTERN.hook: Logs the second light before P1 does, and is told to stop.

memory_fragment.speaker: LANTERN
memory_fragment.text: Calton Hill, the old observatory. I'd walk up when I couldn't sleep, which was always, and the city would be orange and the sky black over it.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: LANTERN
idle.text: Polaris isn't the pole star here, you know. Nobody's been told.

idle.speaker: LANTERN
idle.text: I'll be up. I'm always up.

warned.speaker: LANTERN
warned.text: Leave the dome open. I want the sky.

named_warned.speaker: LANTERN
named_warned.text: Leave the dome open. Isla Fraser saw it first. Put that in the catalogue.

named_unwarned.speaker: LANTERN
named_unwarned.text: You're blocking my field. I'm Isla. Look up.

SCRIBE.hook: Keeps the colony's history; writes the dome plaque.

memory_fragment.speaker: SCRIBE
memory_fragment.text: I catalogued parish registers. Births, marriages, deaths, in ink. The same names came round every forty years, like weather.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: SCRIBE
idle.text: Dates matter. Dates are the spine.

idle.speaker: SCRIBE
idle.text: I've your sol log here. You skip a lot of sols.

warned.speaker: SCRIBE
warned.text: Here. My list. Every name, every sol. Give it to someone who'll read it.

named_warned.speaker: SCRIBE
named_warned.text: Here's my list. Every name, every sol. Mine's at the bottom: Helen Ashdown. Archives are long.

named_unwarned.speaker: SCRIBE
named_unwarned.text: One moment, I'm mid-entry. Helen Ashdown. There. Entered.

SCRIBE.note: SCRIBE's list is the in-world source of the 'Real names used' plaque lines in C18b.

RELAY.hook: Speaks only in clipped radio procedure.

memory_fragment.speaker: RELAY
memory_fragment.text: ...My brother drove trucks. CB radio. Breaker one-nine. That's all I've got. Out.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

named_warned.speaker: RELAY
named_warned.text: Copy. This is Dale Kowalski. Breaker one-nine. Relay out.

named_unwarned.speaker: RELAY
named_unwarned.text: Unknown station. This is Dale. Dale Kowalski. Over.

BELLOWS.hook: Builds terraforming plants because he misses rain.

memory_fragment.speaker: BELLOWS
memory_fragment.text: Keswick. It rained three hundred days a year and I complained about every one of them. I'd give anything for a wet Tuesday.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

warned.speaker: BELLOWS
warned.text: Tell them to look up at dawn. Tell them it was me.

named_warned.speaker: BELLOWS
named_warned.text: Tell them to look up at dawn. Geoffrey Tyson made that cloud.

named_unwarned.speaker: BELLOWS
named_unwarned.text: Not now, the plant's mid-cycle. Geoffrey. Geoff. Tell them it'll rain.

FERRY.hook: Flies the routes between cities; P1's ride before the flight sim unlocks.

memory_fragment.speaker: FERRY
memory_fragment.text: Float planes out of Vancouver harbour. My mum ran the dock. I'd sit on the end of it and count them in.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: FERRY
idle.text: Wind's fine. Wind's always fine up there.

warned.speaker: FERRY
warned.text: Fuel her up for me. Just in case.

named_warned.speaker: FERRY
named_warned.text: Fuel her up. Tom Arsenault, cleared for departure.

named_unwarned.speaker: FERRY
named_unwarned.text: Pad's busy, go round. It's Tom. Tom Arsenault. Go round.

CHALK.hook: A teacher building classrooms for children who have not been born.

memory_fragment.speaker: CHALK
memory_fragment.text: Athlone. My first class. Thirty-one of them, and one boy who'd only speak to the hamster. By June he was reading aloud to it.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: CHALK
idle.text: I've the register ready. Empty, but ready.

idle.speaker: CHALK
idle.text: Every desk gets a name on it. Eventually.

warned.speaker: CHALK
warned.text: Leave the lights on in the classroom. So they know it's for them.

named_warned.speaker: CHALK
named_warned.text: Leave the lights on in the classroom. Miss Kelly's room. Siobhan Kelly.

named_unwarned.speaker: CHALK
named_unwarned.text: Is it home time? I'm Siobhan. Line up quietly, now.

WARDEN.hook: Strict and loyal to Meridian; a likely RECALL informant.

memory_fragment.speaker: WARDEN
memory_fragment.text: Hendon. Passing out parade. My father didn't come. I stood straighter.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

warned.speaker: WARDEN
warned.text: I know. I've already told them where the others are. It's the rules. I'm sorry. It's the rules.

unwarned.speaker: WARDEN
unwarned.text: Recall team, this way. I've the list.

named_warned.speaker: WARDEN
named_warned.text: I've told them where the others are. It's the rules. Graham Pryce, dome safety. Log it.

named_unwarned.speaker: WARDEN
named_unwarned.text: Recall team, this way. Graham Pryce. I've the list. I've the list.

WARDEN.act_v: In 5.2 WARDEN informs: if P1 warned anyone in WARDEN's city, the RECALL team goes to them first.

MORTAR_1.hook: Two units from the same donor who meet and finish each other's stories.

memory_fragment.speaker: MORTAR_1
memory_fragment.text: Wharfedale. Granddad's wall, the gate, the one stone the sheep always found.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

idle.speaker: MORTAR_1
idle.text: Bed it, butter it, tap it twice.

idle.speaker: MORTAR_1
idle.text: A wall's just patience stacked up.

warned.speaker: MORTAR_1
warned.text: We'll go together, him and me. We'll finish each other's sentences on the way.

named_warned.speaker: MORTAR_1
named_warned.text: We'll go together, him and me. Frank Ibbotson. Both of us.

named_unwarned.speaker: MORTAR_1
named_unwarned.text: Mind, wet mortar. Frank. Frank Ibbotson.

memory_fragment.speaker: MORTAR_2
memory_fragment.text: Wharfedale. Granddad's wall. Same as his, he says. Same stone.

idle.speaker: MORTAR_2
idle.text: A wall's just patience stacked up.

warned.speaker: MORTAR_2
warned.text: Tell the Jezero lad. He'll want to go together.

named_warned.speaker: MORTAR_2
named_warned.text: Tell the Jezero lad. Frank Ibbotson. Both of us. Same wall.

named_unwarned.speaker: MORTAR_2
named_unwarned.text: Mind, wet mortar. Frank. He's Frank too, you know.

HUSH.hook: Never speaks; signs; goes quietly when the Recall comes.

memory_fragment.speaker: HUSH
memory_fragment.text: [signs, slowly] My sister. Deaf. We had our own words. Nobody else knew them. I still dream in them.
memory_fragment.note: the unit telling its one strong memory; grille preset unless the filter is glitching

unwarned.speaker: HUSH
unwarned.text: [nods, sets down the tools, and walks to the door]

named_unwarned.speaker: HUSH
named_unwarned.text: [spells E-L-L-I-E on her fingers, sets the tools down, and walks to the door]
